upgrades.name: HEALTH MODULATOR II
upgrades.description: Adds an additional health module slot

upgrades.name: HEALTH MODULATOR III
upgrades.description: Adds an additional health module slot

upgrades.name: LOOT RECALIBRATOR
upgrades.description: Grants ability to reroll module chests

upgrades.name: NANO MED
upgrades.description: Start a run with one full health module

upgrades.name: OPTIC CALIBRATOR
upgrades.description: Provides a crate containing optics at the start of a run

upgrades.name: PLUNDER PULSE I
upgrades.description: Enemies have a chance to drop items

upgrades.description: Enemies have a chance to drop higher tier items

upgrades.name: SUPPLY CRATE MODULE I
upgrades.description: Start a run with a modification chest

upgrades.name: SUPPLY CRATE MODULE II
upgrades.description: Start a run with two modification chests

upgrades.name: Combat Med
upgrades.description: Heal slightly after clearing an area

upgrades.name: Corruption Cleanse
upgrades.description: Heal slightly when cleansing a corruption

upgrades.name: Credimax
upgrades.description: Credit cannisters and boxes are more effective

upgrades.name: Dynamic Refill
upgrades.description: Refill projectile ammo after area clearance

upgrades.name: Expanded Memory
upgrades.description: Adds additional module slots to weapon

upgrades.name: Munitions Augmentor
upgrades.description: Increases ammo obtained from ammo pickups

upgrades.name: Pyromaniac
upgrades.description: Explosive cubes will have elemental variants

upgrades.name: Recycler
upgrades.description: Exchange unused mods for currency at shop locations

upgrades.name: Scavenger
upgrades.description: Chance for enemies to drop items

upgrades.name: Supply Crate Module
upgrades.description: Provides loot crates on run start

upgrades.name: Voidmax
upgrades.description: Voidium cannisters and boxes are more effective
